summary.headline: Conjunction Judgment and Astronomical Table
summary.text: Judicial astrological judgment for a conjunction on Friday, associating the Moon’s separation to Mars’s trine with agricultural damage in Armarvi from snow and hail, and with the destruction of rulers, armies, grandees, and highwaymen. A tabular set of astronomical and astrological values follows, covering twilight, midnight, midday, transits, divisors, Hyleg progressions, orbits, longitude and latitude, climates, and altitudes.
